create_camera_from_extrinsics_intrinsics: create a Camera from extrinsics and intrinsics matrices using Camera.new with shape validation and broadcasting
create_camera_at_origin: create a Camera at the world origin with identity extrinsics using Camera.at_origin and given intrinsics
create_camera_in_frame: create a Camera positioned in a specified world frame using Camera.in_frame with a Frame and intrinsics
get_camera_projection_matrix: get the 3x4 camera projection matrix from a Camera instance using the projection property
get_camera_center_and_principal_ray: get the camera center in world coordinates and principal ray using the center and principal_ray properties
